topic_title: Interpreting the Meaning of the Derivative in Context

items.title: Question 9

prompt.normalized_html:
Susan, the new receptionist of the Smithsonian Museum in Washington DC, uses the following three functions to model the daily number of visitors to the museum [MATH: t] minutes after the museum has opened.

  • [MATH: N(t)] - the number of people inside the museum

  • [MATH: E(t)] - the rate at which people enter the museum

  • [MATH: L(t)] - the rate at which people leave the museum

What is the relationship between the three functions above?

items.title: Question 10

prompt.normalized_html:
Jason, a biologist, is measuring the growth of bacteria in a Petri dish by recording the following two numbers for different values of [MATH: t,] where [MATH: t] is the time, in hours, since he started his observations:

  • [MATH: N(t)] - the number of bacteria in the dish.

  • [MATH: r(t)] - the rate at which the number of bacteria in the dish is increasing.

What is the relationship between [MATH: N(t)] and [MATH: r(t)?]
